input_source: three real LibriSpeech waveforms from the declared audio bank
reference_check: native Conv1d versus explicit padded depthwise window FP32 multiply-accumulate and original-dtype writeback
interpretation: The explicit reference has the same padded window semantics and agrees with a high-precision Conv1d up to the original BF16 writeback. The large training differences in the natural probe therefore arise primarily in the backward weight-gradient accumulation path, not from an indexing or padding mismatch.
claim_boundary: Three-state execution check for the declared Gemma-4 audio depthwise boundary; it does not establish a population or long-run training claim.
